def rpn_band: if . <= 5 then 1 elif . <= 15 then 2 elif . <= 35 then 3 elif . <= 70 then 4 else 5 end;
def acyclic($left;$done):
 if ($left|length)==0 then true
 else [$left[] | select(all(.dependencies[]; . as $dep | ($done|index($dep)) != null))] as $ready
 | if ($ready|length)==0 then false else
 ($ready|map(.id)) as $ids |
 acyclic([$left[] | select(.id as $id | ($ids|index($id)) == null)]; $done+$ids)
 end end;
. as $c |
{
 counts: (.counts.source_records == (.source_records|length) and .counts.bookmarks == ([.source_records[]|select(.kind=="bookmark")]|length) and .counts.workspaces == ([.source_records[]|select(.kind=="workspace")]|length) and .counts.distinct_heads == (.heads|length) and .counts.distinct_outside_nonempty_commits == (.unintegrated_changes|length)),
 unique_source_records: (([.source_records[]|[.kind,.name]]|unique|length)==.counts.source_records),
 unique_heads: (([.heads[].commit]|unique|length)==.counts.distinct_heads),
 full_commit_ids: (all(.heads[].commit; test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$")) and (.main_commit|test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$"))),
 source_heads_resolve: all(.source_records[]; .head_commit as $id | any($c.heads[]; .commit==$id)),
 outside_union: (([.heads[].unintegrated_nonempty[].commit]|unique|sort)==([.unintegrated_changes[].commit]|unique|sort)),
 stage_coverage: all(.unintegrated_changes[]; .stage_id as $id | any($c.stages[]; .id==$id)),
 dag_refs_resolve: all(.stages[].dependencies[]; . as $id | any($c.stages[]; .id==$id)),
 dag_acyclic: acyclic(.stages;[]),
 risk_arithmetic: all(.stages[]; .score == ([.factors[]]|reduce .[] as $x (1; .*$x)) and .fmea.rpn == (.fmea.s*.fmea.o*.fmea.det) and .fmea.band == ([.fmea.s, (.fmea.rpn|rpn_band)]|max) and .factors.F == .fmea.band),
 specification_not_dispatch: all(.stages[]; .activation=="SPECIFICATION_ONLY_NOT_DISPATCHED"),
 every_worktree_unfrozen_explicit: all(.source_records[]|select(.kind=="workspace"); .dirty_worktree_status=="UNSNAPSHOTTED_BYTES_NOT_INSPECTED_OR_FROZEN")
} | . as $results | if all(.[]; . == true) then $results else error("planning invariant failure: "+($results|tostring)) end
